metaTitle: Custom Tri Blend Babies & Toddlers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order soft custom tri blend babies & toddlers apparel in bulk. Perfect for company picnics and family events.
introHtml: Tri blend fabric — a mix of cotton, polyester, and rayon — offers a softness that babies and toddlers love, making it ideal for custom apparel that parents will actually keep. Unlike standard cotton, tri blend resists shrinking and fading after repeated washes. For your next company family picnic or employee gift, these custom tri blend babies & toddlers pieces provide a premium feel that reflects well on your brand. Screen printing and embroidery both adhere cleanly to this fabric blend.
